description: Superservicios-Información de Accidentes de Origen Eléctrico-Formato19 is a dataset listed in Colombian national open data portal (datos.gov.co), an open data portal (Socrata), published or maintained by Superintendencia de Servicios Públicos Domiciliarios SuperServicios, Bogotá D.C. Superintendecia de Servicios Públicos - Información de Accidentes de Origen Eléctrico-Formato19. Coverage: Superintendencia de Servicios Públicos Domiciliarios SuperServicios, Bogotá D.C. The portal files it under the publisher Superintendencia de Servicios Públicos Domiciliarios SuperServicios, Bogotá D.C. Its tags are accidentes electricos, información de accidentes, electricidad. It offers 2 resource(s) in CSV, JSON. The portal files it under the category Minas y Energía. The portal shows 2024-04-15 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-SA-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and charging-infrastructure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-datos-gov-co-portal.
